governance.class: positive list — nothing appears by default
governance.change_process: BCR §3.11 CK-B governed change (Owner + effective delay + objection path). Adding a new tier requires a dated ruling in docs/rulings/ and a supplementary snapshot in tests/invariants/.

entries.meaning: Standard operating mode: all three de-id layers (regex + tenant catalogue + spaCy NER) applied and PASSED. No degradation.
LLM absent or SYNISENSE_LLM_MODE=mock; Shield returns the de-identified content unchanged through the reidentify pass. Preserves round-trip semantics for tests without burning provider budget.

Layer 3 (spaCy NER) has no model for the detected language AND the tenant catalogue (layer 2) has no hits for this call. If proper-noun density is below threshold, this tier lands; if above, the call fails-closed with ServiceUnavailable per language_dispatch.fail_closed_language_guard.
Faster-whisper unavailable; pipeline fell back to whisper-tiny variant per perception_fallback_allowlist. Trust receipt records the fallback so downstream verification can class the result.
Umbrella tier for any dev-mode degradation not otherwise classed. Emitted only under AKKI_ENV=development; production emissions of this tier are refused at write time.
